data.cultural_impact: The name Truman has a notable place in American history as it was borne by Harry S. Truman, the 33rd President of the United States. Truman rose to prominence as President Roosevelt's vice president, and upon Roosevelt's death in 1945, Truman assumed the presidency. He led the country through the end of World War II, the onset of the Cold War, and the beginning of the United States' involvement in the Korean War. The name came to represent steadfastness and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: Truman can also be seen as a symbol of faithfulness and trustworthiness in the spiritual sense.
